rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for two matching things taken together or two people forming a couple.

example.english: This pair of shoes goes well with my trousers.
example.jyutping: ni1 jat1 deoi3 haai4 hou2 can3 ngo5 tiu4 fu3

rows.meaning: pair of; two items of a plural noun
rows.note: Use the appropriate Cantonese classifier when a binary noun is treated as one unit, such as 一把剪刀 or 一副眼鏡.

example.english: I bought a pair of scissors.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 baa2 zin2 dou1
